jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
Overview

Mesh is building the financial operating system that connects exchanges, wallets, and payment flows across the digital asset ecosystem. As we scale, we're looking for a Chief of Staff to be the CEO's closest strategic partner and the executive who makes the company run.

Reporting directly to our Founder and CEO, you'll own how Mesh operates. You'll set the operating rhythm, drive the company's highest-priority initiatives, oversee the Business Operations function, and build Mesh's M&A and Corporate Development function from the ground up. You'll extend the CEO's reach across the company, turning strategy into plans, plans into accountable owners, and owners into results. This is an executive seat on the leadership team: you'll own outcomes, not just coordinate them, and you'll be the person who sources, negotiates, and closes the deals that expand Mesh's reach across crypto and payments.

What You'll Do

 - Act as the CEO's strategic thinking partner on company priorities, key decisions, and tradeoffs, and represent the CEO with the exec team, board, partners, and investors

 - Own Mesh's operating rhythm: annual and quarterly planning, OKRs, weekly leadership reviews, exec meetings, and town halls, so priorities are clear, progress is visible, and decisions don't stall

 - Lead board and investor readiness, including quarterly board updates, exec summaries, and company performance reporting built on a single source of truth for key metrics

 - Oversee the Business Operations function, partnering with the Biz Ops lead to set priorities, remove blockers, and raise the bar for how cross-functional work is scoped, run, and measured

 - Drive CEO special projects end to end, from new markets and strategic partnerships (exchanges, wallets, on/off-ramp partners) to pricing and unit economics

 - Hold the executive team accountable to company goals, surface risks early, and resolve the cross-functional issues that sit between teams

 - Partner with People on org design, executive hiring, internal communications, and culture

 - Build the systems, dashboards, and AI-powered workflows that make company performance easy to see and let Mesh scale efficiently

Who You Are

 - 10+ years of experience, including senior leadership in strategy and operations, business operations, corporate development, or as a Chief of Staff to a CEO at a high-growth company

 - A proven leader who has built a function from scratch, including hiring and managing the team

 - Has owned (not just supported) a company operating cadence: planning, OKRs, exec reviews, and board preparation at a scaling startup

 - Executive presence and sound judgment; trusted by the CEO, board, and exec team, and comfortable giving direct feedback upward

 - Exceptional written and verbal communicator who can turn complexity into clear narratives for the board, leadership, and the whole company

 - Data-driven and commercially minded; comfortable building models and owning company metrics

 - Deep experience in crypto and/or payments processing (stablecoins, exchanges, wallets, on/off-ramps, card and payment networks, regulatory licensing), with a network across the ecosystem

 - Experience in high-growth startup environments (Series B and beyond preferred) and able to travel, including internationally

 - Able to be in the office 3 days a week
jobs.investor: General Catalyst, Y Combinator, Samsung Next

jobs.title: Head of Corporate Development
jobs.description:
Mesh is hiring its first dedicated Corporate Development lead, a foundational role with a direct impact on the company’s trajectory. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, finance, and technology, you'll need to be as comfortable in a data room as you are interrogating an API integration or stress-testing a settlement architecture with an engineering team.

This is an opportunity to build and own our M&A and strategic partnerships function from the ground up. You’ll define how we identify, evaluate, and execute high-impact opportunities, working closely with leadership to shape where Mesh goes next.

From setting strategy to building a pipeline to closing deals, you’ll operate across the full lifecycle, expanding our capabilities, licensing footprint, and distribution through thoughtful, well-executed partnerships and acquisitions.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in early, unstructured environments, takes initiative, and is excited to turn ambition into action.

What You'll Do

 - Build and own a high-quality pipeline of M&A opportunities and strategic partnerships across the crypto payments ecosystem

 - Lead deals end-to-end: from first outreach through diligence, negotiation, and close

 - Run rigorous diligence across financials, product architecture, API integrations, and commercial viability, you'll go deep enough on the technical stack to assess build-vs-buy tradeoffs, evaluate integration complexity, and identify engineering risk before it becomes a deal problem

 - Develop investment theses, deal frameworks, and scoring models; present insights directly to the CEO, SVP, and board

 - Partner closely with Legal and Finance to structure and negotiate deals that actually get done

 - Stay on top of the competitive landscape, tracking key players, emerging trends, and whitespace opportunities

 - Build and manage relationships with investment banks, advisors, and potential targets, becoming a go-to player in the ecosystem

Who You Are

 - Bachelor’s Degree in Business or Finance or related field

 - 5+ years of experience in investment banking, growth, venture capital, product, or strategy roles, or in-house corporate development at a fintech or crypto company

 - You actually run deals, leading M&A or strategic partnerships from first conversation through close

 - Deep understanding of the fintech and payments industry (on-ramps, off-ramps, PSPs, acquirers, banking partners) and how money actually moves, including working knowledge of EMI / MSB / money transmitter licensing and the regulatory side of the stack

 - Strong grasp of crypto payments infrastructure (stablecoins, on/off-ramps, exchange integrations, custody, compliance),  you know how the pieces fit together in the real world

 - You've evaluated or worked closely with crypto infrastructure at the API layer, whether that's exchange integrations, wallet SDKs, stablecoin settlement rails, or on/off-ramp architecture, and you understand how these systems connect in a real production environment

 - Comfortable getting into the weeds with crypto APIs and exchange integrations (or quick to ramp if you haven’t yet)

 - Sharp financial instincts with the ability to build models from scratch and pressure-test assumptions like a skeptic

 - Technically fluent enough to evaluate a target's API architecture, assess integration complexity into Mesh's stack, and hold a credible diligence conversation with an engineering team, you don't write code, but you know what questions to ask and what the answers mean

 - Clear, concise communicator who can turn complexity into compelling, board-ready narratives

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager, APAC
jobs.description:
Overview

Mesh is expanding into APAC and we are looking for a Senior Business Development Manager. This is a senior individual contributor role responsible for owning Mesh Pay's merchant and payment partnership pipeline across the Asia-Pacific region, with a primary focus on Singapore, Southeast Asia, South Korea, and Japan. The hire will identify, pitch, and close B2B deals with payment gateways, PSPs, acquiring banks, and crypto-ready merchants looking to embed crypto payment infrastructure. It's a full-cycle sales role, meaning the person owns everything from prospecting through close, not just pipeline management or relationship maintenance. Given Mesh Pay's Series C momentum and active APAC expansion, this person will have real autonomy and direct leadership visibility, but will also need to be comfortable operating independently in a lean, high-velocity environment across jurisdictions with varying regulatory postures. You'll work directly with the CEO of APAC and engage regularly with Mesh's global leadership, product, and BD teams.

What You'll Do

 - Own the merchant and PSP sales pipeline across APAC — identify, qualify, pitch, and close B2B partnerships with payment gateways, acquiring banks, PSPs, and merchants seeking crypto payment infrastructure

 - Build and maintain a high-quality pipeline of 20+ target accounts across Singapore, SEA, South Korea, and Japan, with particular focus on crypto-ready merchants and digital payment platforms

 - Lead commercial negotiations and structure partnerships with PSPs and merchant acquirers integrating Mesh Pay's deposits and payments APIs

 - Develop account plans for strategic targets; coordinate with Solutions Engineering and Product on technical requirements and integration scoping

Who You Are

 - 6+ years in B2B sales or business development in payments, with meaningful time in merchant acquiring, PSP partnerships, or payment gateway BD

 - Demonstrable track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder commercial deals — not pipeline management, actual closed revenue

 - Deep familiarity with the APAC payments landscape: acquirer relationships, PSP ecosystems, and how merchants make vendor decisions across SEA, Korea, or Japan

 - Existing network in the merchant payments or PSP space in APAC — this is non-negotiable; we are not building your rolodex from scratch

 - Strong grasp of crypto payments, stablecoins, and digital asset infrastructure; you do not need to be an engineer but you need to speak credibly on these topics

 - Experience managing the full sales cycle independently — prospecting through close — in a lean or early-stage environment

 - Mandarin proficiency preferred (Mandarin-speaking markets are a key growth vector for this role)

 - Comfortable operating across jurisdictions with different regulatory postures; prior exposure to MAS-regulated fintechs or crypto-licensed businesses is a strong plus

 - Prior experience at a crypto exchange, stablecoin issuer, or crypto infrastructure company, preferred

 - Existing relationships at payment platforms active in Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, South Korea, or Japan, preferred

 - Familiarity with API-led commercial partnerships and ability to navigate technical conversations with product and engineering counterparts, preferred

 - Experience with Travel Rule compliance implications for payments businesses in APAC, preferred

jobs.title: Director, Japan Business Development and Responsible Director
jobs.description:
Overview

Mesh is building out its presence in Japan, and we're looking for someone to lead that build from the ground up. This is a dual mandate. Half of the job is commercial: you own Mesh's growth in one of the most important and complex markets in APAC, building relationships with exchanges, PSPs, banks and fintechs. The other half is governance: you'll serve as a director of Mesh's Japan entity, holding statutory responsibility for local representation and board-level accountability. You'll operate with real autonomy from day one. This is not a role where you wait for a playbook. You're building the playbook, the pipeline and the local presence at the same time.

What You'll Do

 - Own Mesh's commercial pipeline in Japan across exchanges, PSPs, banks and fintechs, from first conversation to signed contract

 - Build and manage relationships with the key players in Japan's crypto and payments ecosystem

 - Act as Mesh's primary representative in market, to partners, prospective clients and regulators

 - Serve as a director of Mesh's Japan entity, with statutory responsibility for local governance and board reporting

 - Work closely with Mesh's global business development, legal and compliance teams to keep local activity aligned with company strategy

 - Report regularly to senior leadership on pipeline, market development and commercial progress

 - Partner with Mesh's Compliance Officer and outside counsel to navigate Japan's regulatory environment as the business scales

 - Recruit and manage a small local team as the Japan operation grows

Who You Are

 - 10+ years in payments, fintech or financial services, with meaningful time in crypto or digital assets

 - Experience serving as a company director in Japan, or strong working familiarity with Japanese corporate governance and board obligations

 - A real network across Japan's exchange, PSP and financial services landscape, built over years, not weeks

 - Business-level fluency in both Japanese and English (a native Japanese speaker is preferred, given the nuances of business communication and the complexity of local regulatory contexts)

 - A track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder commercial deals

 - Comfort operating with significant autonomy in a fast-moving, early-stage environment

 - Prior engagement with Japan's Financial Services Agency (FSA) 

 - Based in Tokyo, or able to relocate

Nice to Have

 - Existing relationships with major Japan exchanges or fintech platforms

 - Experience standing up or scaling a regional operation for a global company
   

The estimated base salary for this position is ¥23,973,000 to ¥45,000,000. The compensation range provided may span multiple career levels and will be narrowed during the interview process based on factors including a candidate's experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. The base salary range listed excludes commission (if applicable), equity, and benefits. The pay range represents the minimum and maximum target for new-hire compensation. Actual compensation may vary and may be higher or lower depending on individual circumstances.

jobs.title: Director of Sales
jobs.description:
Overview

Mesh is seeking a driven, high performing sales professional with a true hunter mentality to join our team as a Sales Director. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on solving complex problems, building pipeline from the ground up, and closing meaningful net new business. You will own the full sales cycle end to end, from first conversation through signed contract, playing a direct role in expanding Mesh’s footprint in the market.

In this hands on role, you will spend the majority of your time generating pipeline, engaging decision makers, and driving active deals forward with urgency. You will take full ownership of your territory, uncover customer pain points, and deliver solutions that create real, measurable impact.

This is a fast paced, high ownership environment where strategic selling, outbound prospecting, and a strong drive to win are essential to success.

What You'll Do

 - Own revenue generation by building pipeline, advancing deals, and closing business with consistency

 - Master Mesh’s solutions and become a go-to advisor for prospects navigating complex challenges

 - Drive deals forward with urgency from first touch to close, while continuously developing and sustaining a robust, high quality pipeline

 - Forecast with precision, using data and deal insight to guide outcomes

 - Bring the voice of the customer into the company, helping shape product direction and strategy

 - Open doors in target accounts through thoughtful, strategic prospecting

 - Connect the dots between customer pain points and Mesh’s unique value in a compelling way

 - Leverage AI and modern sales tools to work smarter, personalize outreach, and increase win rates

 - Consistently exceed revenue targets and raise the bar for performance across the team

 - Act as a strong ambassador for Mesh by engaging with customers at events and actively building presence across your network

 - Build and close relationships with enterprise customers, navigating complex, high-value deals

Who You Are

 - 7+ years of quota-carrying experience with a consistent track record of exceeding targets

 - A strong closer with a team-first mindset who thrives in high-performance environments

 - Deep understanding of fintech, crypto, and Web3 (payments, blockchain, digital assets, DeFi)

 - Skilled in complex, consultative sales using frameworks like MEDDIC, Challenger, or similar

 - Operate as a trusted advisor by staying curious, thinking analytically, and focusing on solving meaningful customer challenges

 - Highly organized and data-driven, with demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools and CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot) to improve forecasting accuracy and sales performance

 - Excellent communicator with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels

 - Bring a founder’s mindset by taking full ownership, moving with urgency, and consistently raising the standard for yourself and those around you

What We Value in our Teammates

 - Intellectually Curious: You always want to learn more about your customers' pain points and improve the product.

 - Founder’s Attitude: You take full ownership and responsibility over outcomes. You’re a force of nature that gets the job done no matter what it takes.

 - Force Multiplier: Your presence, positivity, and drive inspire others to step up their game.

 - Constantly Learning: You’re always pushing yourself to learn more, whether that is to be a better sales professional, better leader, etc. You’re not satisfied with the status quo.

jobs.title: Compliance Officer, Japan
jobs.description:
Overview

Mesh is hiring its first dedicated Compliance Officer for its Japan entity. This is a foundational role. You will not inherit a function; you will build one: policies, procedures, and controls designed for a crypto payments infrastructure business operating under Japanese regulation. You will work closely with outside counsel and Mesh’s global compliance team, and you will be the person regulators, partners, and internal stakeholders come to first on anything compliance-related in Japan. The role can start as full-time or as a fractional engagement, depending on the right person.

What You'll Do

 - Design, implement and maintain Mesh Japan’s compliance program, including AML/CFT, KYC and Travel Rule obligations.

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for regulatory engagement and licensing-related workstreams in Japan.

 - Liaise with outside counsel on regulatory filings and ongoing obligations.

 - Build policies and procedures fit for a crypto payments infrastructure business operating in Japan, not adapted from a generic template.

 - Track regulatory developments in Japan’s digital-asset and payments space and advise leadership on what they mean for Mesh.

 - Partner with Mesh’s global compliance, legal and risk teams to keep Japan practices aligned with company-wide standards.

 - Support onboarding and due diligence for new partners and clients in Japan.

 - Prepare compliance reporting for the board and for regulators as required.

Who You Are

 - 5+ years in compliance, regulatory affairs or legal roles within financial services, payments, or crypto and digital assets in Japan.

 - Strong working knowledge of Japan’s regulatory framework for payments and/or crypto-asset businesses.

 - Experience working with or reporting to the FSA or a comparable regulator, directly or through counsel.

 - Experience with financial license applications with Regional Finance Bureaus (RFB) and the FSA.

 - Business-level fluency in Japanese and English; native Japanese speaker preferred.

 - Comfort building a function from the ground up with limited initial resources.

 - High attention to detail and strong written communication for policy and regulatory documents.

jobs.title: Senior Compliance Director
jobs.description:
What You'll Do

 - Own and evolve Mesh's compliance program across crypto, traditional finance (TradFi), and DeFi-adjacent product lines, ensuring the program scales alongside the business.

 - Analyze existing and proposed legislation, regulatory guidance, and industry practices across multiple jurisdictions, translating them into practical policies and procedures for the business.

 - Serve as a senior advisor to Product and Engineering on the compliance implications of new features, wallet integrations, on-chain/off-chain payment flows, and international market expansion.

 - Design and validate control processes for regulatory reporting, transaction monitoring, and licensing obligations across the jurisdictions Mesh operates in.

 - Partner with business unit leaders to respond to inquiries, exams, and reports issued by regulatory agencies or auditors, both domestic and international.

 - Act as a primary point of contact with outside regulators, government officials, banking partners, and senior business unit managers.

 - Lead and mentor compliance team members, building out the function as the company grows.

 - Monitor global regulatory developments affecting crypto, stablecoins, and digital asset payments, and help shape Mesh's positioning and readiness ahead of new requirements.

 - Chair Mesh's Compliance Oversight Committee, driving cross-functional accountability for regulatory risk.

 - Build and maintain a basic compliance risk assessment and testing program, in partnership with the risk management function.

Who You Are

 - BA/BS required; MBA, JD, or professional certification (e.g., CAMS, CRCM) preferred.

 - 10+ years of relevant compliance, legal, or regulatory experience, with meaningful exposure to both crypto/digital assets and traditional financial services (TradFi); DeFi familiarity a strong plus.

 - Direct experience obtaining and maintaining Money Transmitter License (MTL) approvals across U.S. states.

 - Thorough experience with AML/BSA and Code of Ethics programs, sanctions, and licensing frameworks relevant to crypto payments.

 - Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and written/verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex regulatory concepts for technical and non-technical audiences alike.

 - Ability to handle high-stakes, ambiguous situations with internal stakeholders and regulators while maintaining a calm, professional approach.

 - Strong track record engaging with senior management, as well as federal, state, and international regulators.

 - Strong interpersonal and influencing skills, with the ability to drive business decisions without direct authority.

 - Preferred: experience building or scaling a compliance function at a high-growth fintech or crypto company.

 - Preferred: hands-on understanding of digital asset transaction lifecycles, custody, and settlement.
